events.text: Team Leader, run the map past me one more time.

Okay, that checks out. Keep going.

I'll take it — that checks out well enough.
We're waiting on the key. Can you confirm?

The map — I think we jumped on that one.

Code Breaker, we're waiting on the key.
Use it carefully: magnetic key, attached to the metal panel.
Good. Don't slow down.

Good. One piece down.
